q1_issues.issue: 'over the Cold Sea' is slotted as Location, but Location is specified for in/at/on and the instruction set requires the preposition actually used rather than a near-fit named role, so the surface-preposition oblique (Over <event> cold_sea) is the licensed form; Location asserts the coming is situated at the sea rather than passing over it.

notes: The named place is handled exactly per the multi-word-name rule (one opaque symbol, Name string, separate kind atom, no modifier genus for 'Cold'), the bare-plural generic correctly becomes a distributing rule at (STV 0.9 0.9), and Patient on the storm's motion follows the non-volitional-natural-force branch of the intransitive test.
